what: Decided the cutover design as the brain: C0 is the host commit of the cutover job's own landing (named by [history] cutover_job), athena land performs the import and writes the legacy-exempt record when it lands that job, the required 'the full history' job hands commits after C0 to the attribution check, and trailers end in a later job; re-queued jobs 7a, 7a-b, 7b and 8 accordingly.
why: The queued cutover would have had a producer write to the real records branch, which its sandbox cannot reach, and would have needed a ruleset change to make a new CI job required; both are avoided by these choices.
